timetable.open.tooltip: Change departures, tours and running times of the map's lines
timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.description: Change when the trips of a line leave and how long they take. Nothing is written until you apply; the lines on the map are read again afterwards. Only the timetable of the base map is edited, not that of a chrono variant.
timetable.empty: The map has no line files in its TTData folder.
timetable.tour.add.tooltip: Adds an empty tour at the end
timetable.tour.remove.tooltip: Removes the tour with all its trips
timetable.tour.name: Tour name
timetable.shift.tooltip: Moves every trip of the tour by these minutes (negative: earlier)
timetable.series.add.tooltip: Adds the trip at these departures to the tour: first, last, and the minutes between two
timetable.trip.time.tooltip: Departure as H:MM, H:MM:SS or minutes after midnight
timetable.trip.profile.tooltip: Which profile (running time) of the trip file is used
timetable.trip.remove.tooltip: Remove this trip from the tour
timetable.running.hint: How long a trip takes from its first to its last stop, per profile. They apply to every tour that runs the trip.
timetable.status.failed: The timetable could not be changed: {reason}
timetable.status.bad_series: Enter a first and a last time, and an interval over 0 minutes.
timetable.days.tooltip: The days the tour runs: weekdays, public holidays, and school days or school holidays
